background.description: Plain light-coloured background (white preferred), recent colour passport-style photo

notes: Verified against the official CRP Clerks/CSA-XVI notification (Annexure IV), dated 1 August 2026: photo dimensions 200x230 pixels (preferred), 20-50 KB, JPEG — identical to IBPS PO's requirement. IBPS additionally requires capturing a live photograph via webcam or mobile during the application, on top of this uploaded file.
